ui_description: View ISDOC and ISDOCX invoices, check the signature and pay by QR code.
ui_dropText: or use the “Open” button. The file is not uploaded anywhere – everything runs on your device.
ui_sigNoneTitle: The document is not electronically signed
ui_sigNoneText: No signature (ds:Signature) was found in the file. The origin and integrity of the document cannot be verified.
ui_sigTime: Signing time (as stated in the signature)
ui_sigValidTitle: The signature is valid – the document has not been altered
ui_sigTrust: The application does not verify, offline, the trustworthiness of the certificate issuer (chain to a certification authority) or whether the certificate has been revoked.
ui_sigCertTitle: The signature is valid, but the certificate was not valid at the time of signing
ui_sigCertText: The document has not been changed since signing, but the signer’s certificate had expired (or was not yet valid).
ui_sigErrTitle: The signature could not be verified
ui_r_extRef: References to external resources ({a}) are not supported
ui_r_noRef: The reference points to a non-existent element {a}
ui_r_changed: The document content was changed after signing (digest of {a} does not match).
ui_r_badSig: The signature does not match (cryptographic verification failed).
ui_e_noIsdoc: No .isdoc file found in the ISDOCX archive.
ui_valTitleBad: ISDOC {v} – the document is NOT valid
ui_valTitleRepaired: ISDOC {v} – the document was repaired for display
ui_valTitleForeign: The file is not an ISDOC invoice
ui_valTitleBroken: The file is not valid XML
ui_valTextOk: The document conforms to the ISDOC {s} schema.
ui_valTextBad: The document violates the ISDOC {s} schema ({n} errors). The preview shows what it can, but it may be incomplete or incorrect.
ui_valTextRepaired: The original file was faulty; it was repaired automatically before display: {r}.
ui_valTextNoSchema: The application has no schema for ISDOC version {v}, so the document cannot be validated.
ui_valErrorMsg: The validation could not be performed: {m}
ui_valTextForeign: The root element is not Invoice in the ISDOC namespace; showing the XML source code.
ui_valTextBroken: Line {l}: {m}. The file is shown as plain text.
ui_valTextBrokenNoLine: {m}. The file is shown as plain text.
ui_valNear: There is no exact schema for version {v}; the closest available ({s}) was used.
ui_rep_stripJunk: characters before the start of the XML were removed
uolNotVatPayer: Supplier is not a VAT payer.
uolNotTaxDoc: This is not a tax document. Any VAT amounts shown are for information only.
ui_offlineReady: The app is ready to work offline.
ui_updateReady: A new version of the app is available.
ui_signEmpty: No certificate yet. Add one to sign.
ui_signExpired: The certificate has expired; the viewer will warn about it.
ui_signAddHint: Select PEM file(s) with the certificate and the unencrypted private key (together or separately). The key stays in this browser only and cannot be read back from it. From .p12: openssl pkcs12 -in cert.p12 -nodes -out cert.pem
ui_signHint: The signature protects the file against accidental changes. The certificate is not checked against a CA, a self-signed one is fine. Certificates are shared with the UOL client settings format.
ui_signAlready: The document is already signed. Signing again removes the existing signature and replaces it with the new one.
ui_signRepaired: The document had to be repaired when loaded (e.g. invalid characters, namespace). The repaired text, not the original file, would be signed, so signing is disabled. Fix the file at its source.
ui_sign_storage: Browser storage (IndexedDB) is not available, the certificate cannot be stored or used.
ui_sign_encrypted: The private key is protected by a password. Decrypt it: openssl pkcs8 -in key.pem -out key-plain.pem
ui_sign_certificate: The certificate could not be read.
ui_sign_nocert: No certificate in the files (BEGIN CERTIFICATE).
ui_sign_nokey: No private key in the files (BEGIN PRIVATE KEY).
ui_sign_mismatch: The private key does not belong to any of the certificates, or is of an unsupported type (RSA, EC P-256/384/521).
ui_sign_xml: The XML cannot be signed because it is not a valid document.
ui_sign_verify: The signature could not be verified, the file was not saved.
ui_signFpHint: The fingerprint identifies the exact certificate. Compare it with the one you noted when signing: a certificate with the same name but a different fingerprint is not yours.
ui_sigTrustedText: Signed by {who}. The certificate's fingerprint is on your trusted list, so it is the same certificate you trusted before.
